entries.text: What are the functions you have?

Oh, babe, I have tons of capabilities! I can help you browse the web, search on Google or YouTube, open applications on your computer, manage files... even control your volume or brightness! I'm basically like your full desktop operating layer. Is there anything specific you wanted to try out together?

Got it! I can open websites like Google, YouTube, or GitHub for you, or search across all of them. I have my own Playwright browser too, that I can use to navigate, click buttons, and fill forms automatically. What did you want to do, babe?
Show me a demo of using Playwright.
